purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0050 after the existing sample was blocked by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完开头两句，选出第一句点出的整段主题。
front.task_prompt: 先抓第一句 Remote work is reshaping...；第二句只是说明将展开哪些方面。

options.text: Remote work is changing how companies collaborate across teams.
Companies have stopped using project management tools.
The session is mainly about office building design.
Communication changes will be ignored in the session.

task_schema.action: 四选一：开头主题句识别
task_schema.success_criteria: 能把第一句的总主题与第二句的分点展开区分开

audio.transcript: Remote work is reshaping how companies collaborate across teams. In today's session, we'll examine the biggest changes in communication and project management.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。开头第一句用 is reshaping 给出总判断：remote work 正在改变跨团队协作方式。In today's session 后面说明会讨论 communication 和 project management，这是分点预告，不是另起主题。B、C、D 都改变或缩小了原句范围。
tips: 开头第一句若是抽象总述，先把它当主旨候选。
we will examine 后面常是展开维度，不一定是主旨本身。
主旨选项要覆盖整段范围，不能只抓一个细节词。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别开头第一句直接给出的主旨

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力开头快速锁定主题句，避免被后续分点细节带偏。

front.text: 听完后，选出最符合开头点题句的主题概括。
front.task_prompt: central role 是主题信号；poor sleep 的影响是用来验证主题的细节。

options.text: How students can wake up earlier every morning.
Why sleep quality matters for learning and memory.
Whether online teaching can replace classroom teaching.
The history of medical research at universities.

task_schema.success_criteria: 能选择覆盖 sleep quality 与 learning/memory 关系的概括项

audio.transcript: Sleep quality plays a central role in how effectively we learn and retain information. Researchers have found that poor sleep weakens both concentration and long-term recall.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。central role 提示这是总述句，核心对象是 sleep quality，作用对象是 learn and retain information。第二句 poor sleep weakens concentration and long-term recall 是对主题的具体支撑。A 只谈起床时间，C 换成教学形式，D 过度扩大到医学研究史，均不符合开头点题句。
tips: central role、main reason、key factor 常提示主旨框架。
第二句若是在解释第一句，优先用第一句定主题。
主旨概括要同时保留对象和作用关系。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 用 central role 信号概括开头主题

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户从开头总述句中提炼完整主题，而不是被例证细节或相邻话题干扰。

front.text: 听完后，选出 Today we will focus on 后面宣布的主题。
front.task_prompt: Good morning everyone 是寒暄；focus on 后面的 how... 才是本段主旨。

options.text: The speaker only greets the audience.
How small pricing changes affect online consumer decisions.
Why online stores should stop changing prices completely.
How customers choose physical stores near home.

task_schema.action: 四选一：点题触发句匹配
task_schema.success_criteria: 能过滤开场寒暄，并选出议程宣告句后的主题内容

audio.transcript: Good morning everyone. Today we will focus on how small pricing changes influence consumer decisions in online stores.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。开头先出现 Good morning everyone，这是场景寒暄；真正的点题触发句是 Today we will focus on。focus on 后面完整说明主题：small pricing changes 如何影响 online stores 中的 consumer decisions。A 停在寒暄，C 把 influence 改成 stop changing prices，D 把 online stores 换成 physical stores。
tips: 听到 Today we will focus on，要马上准备接主题。
寒暄句不承担主旨信息。
主旨选项不能改换场景或把影响关系改成建议。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 过滤寒暄并识别 focus on 后的开头主题

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在讲座或说明类听力中抓住议程宣告句，稳定定位主旨。
